title: Bhikaji Narain Dhakras v. State of Madhya Pradesh

content.caseIdentity: Bhikaji Narain Dhakras v. State of Madhya Pradesh, AIR 1955 SC 781
content.holding: Pre-Constitution laws inconsistent with Fundamental Rights are not dead but eclipsed; when the constitutional impediment is removed by amendment, the law revives automatically without re-enactment.
content.relevance: Classic landmark establishing the Doctrine of Eclipse.

propositionVerification.note: Official Supreme Court judgment directly identifies the case, date and citation and explains the doctrine of eclipse.
